blocked.hostResolverRules: MAP www.googletagmanager.com ~NOTFOUND, MAP *.google-analytics.com ~NOTFOUND, MAP analytics.google.com ~NOTFOUND, MAP *.doubleclick.net ~NOTFOUND, MAP wcs.naver.com ~NOTFOUND, MAP wcs.naver.net ~NOTFOUND, MAP wcs.pstatic.net ~NOTFOUND

method.interaction: Event Timing interactionId duration (max over the tap’s entries, INP definition) when the target DOM state was reached inside the click handler (MutationObserver time ≤ click processingEnd); otherwise rAF+MessageChannel after the frame that first shows it, measured from the tap’s touchstart/pointerdown timeStamp.
method.tap: page.touchscreen.tap at the element centre (CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent), no Playwright actionability during the measured window
method.longTask: From navigation start to just before the first tap: PerformanceObserver longtask entries (>50ms), attributed with long-animation-frame scripts (sourceURL host; third-party when ≥50% of the script time in the task is another host), plus every long-animation-frame whose rendering phase (frame end − renderStart) is >50ms with no longtask entry over it (one rendering task the Long Tasks API did not report; ours unless third-party rAF scripts dominate).
method.calibration: same page at the end of each visit: the loop 5× at rate 4, then 5× at rate 1; slowdown = median of the last 3 at rate 4 / median of the last 3 at rate 1.
method.memory: CDP HeapProfiler.collectGarbage ×2, then Performance.getMetrics (JSHeapUsedSize, Nodes, JSEventListeners), Memory.getDOMCounters, in-page element counts.
